A Dell Pro Precision 5 16 (BIOS 0.4.53) running kernel 6.17.0-1011-oem emits this warning at boot: "WARNING: CPU: 6 PID: 55 at fs/kernfs/dir.c:1706 kernfs_remove_by_name_ns+0xe9/0xf0 — kernfs: can not remove 'typec', no directory", raised from typec_unregister_partner -> ucsi_unregister_partner inside ucsi_handle_connector_change (workqueue events, Comm: kworker/6:0). Find the root cause in the kernel source and determine whether an existing fix is already present in this tree or upstream.
